info.name: Java CoBan API
info.description:
# Java CoBan API Collection - Execution Guide

This collection is structured for sequential execution with **Postman Collection Runner** or manual step-by-step testing.

## Automated Execution Flow
1. **01. Auth**: Registers account, logs in, stores JWT token into , and checks account profile.
2. **02. Student**: Generates a unique student code (), creates student, stores , views, updates, lists, and exports CSV.
3. **03. Academic Foundation**: Creates Academic Year (), Grade Level (), and School Class ().
4. **04. Semesters & Subjects**: Creates Semester (), activates it, creates Subject (), configures applicabilities, and creates Class Subject ().
5. **05. Teacher**: Creates teacher profile (), views, lists, and updates teacher data.
6. **06. Enrollment**: Lists unassigned students, enrolls  into , checks rosters, history, and transfers.
7. **07. Assignment**: Assigns homeroom teacher to class and subject teacher to class-subject.
8. **08. Calendar**: Sets up academic calendar days.
9. **09. Attendance**: Creates attendance session, checks rosters, upserts exceptions, and verifies student attendance history.
10. **10. Lifecycle & Decision**: Ends assignments, evaluates semester completeness checkpoint, tests lock/reopen, and closes class/year.
11. **11. Cleanup & Logout**: Cleans up test resources (deletions) and logs out.

## Note on Runner Options
- If you want to keep created test data in the database, uncheck folder **11. Cleanup & Logout** before clicking **Run Collection**.
